title: Low-Density Polyethylene Films for Packaging — Specification

clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: IS 2508 specifies requirements for LDPE films used in food and general packaging. Covers thickness tolerance, tensile strength, elongation at break, dart impact strength, seal strength, and optical properties. Food-grade LDPE must be free from heavy metals and conform to IS 9845 for food contact.
